<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex105022023-10-06-102531" status="unreviewed" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><lb n="29a2-29a5"/>bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa la 'jug pa'i sgo [29a3] thog ma ; gang dang ldan pas nang pa sangs rgyas par 'jog pa’i khyad chos bla na med ; ci bsam pa’i don rnams myur du 'grub par byed pa’i thabs kyi <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5409"> mchog dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song nas de'i bslabs bya la rnams la</rs> <lb n="29a4"/> <rs type="work">slob pa'i tshul</rs> phyin ci ma log par dam pa rnams kyi gsung la brten ste legs par bshad pa 'di ni mang du thos pa'i dge slong song ba pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4113">dkon mchog gsum gyi 'bang</rs> zhes bya bas : <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5722">dpal byams chen</rs> gyi gnas su legs <lb n="29a5"/> par sbyar ro || ||
            'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya che po 'byung bar gyur cig | || dge'o||</seg></TEI>
